# Local Gear-Defense Affix Pooling (Armour / Energy Shield / Evasion)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** defense, pooling, gear

## Setup

Equip a chest and/or shield carrying both a local flat defense affix (e.g. "+N Armour"/"+N Energy Shield"/"+N Evasion", which routes to the *_gear_flat stat) and a local "% increased" affix on the SAME item (*_gear_inc), alongside a second equipped item that also carries local flat defense but no local increase of its own. Compare the per-item Armour/Energy Shield/Evasion breakdown values.

## Raw data points

Not yet screenshot-verified against the in-game gear tooltip / Defense panel.

## Derived / confirmed formula

Per equipped item: item_total = item's own raw local flat × (1 + sum of that SAME item's own local % increased sources, including any talent-granted "Defense from Chest Armor"/"Defense from Shield"/"Energy Shield gained from Shield" lines scoped to a chest or shield). The stat's overall *_flat total is the sum of every item's item_total (plus any non-gear source landing on the same *_gear_flat key, applied unscaled — see implementation note). This REPLACES the prior model, where every equipped item's local flat summed into one pool and every local % increased (from any item) applied to that WHOLE pool — i.e. a % increased affix on item A previously also scaled item B's local flat, which is not how a "local" (this-item-only) affix conventionally works.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine (2026-09-03, commits "Fix local chest and shield defense modifiers" / "Fix local defense source breakdown"); not yet confirmed against a live in-game gear tooltip or Defense panel screenshot. The per-item scoping (a "local" affix only affects its own item) matches how local affixes work generically across the genre and is corroborated by the existing code comment history ("*_gear_flat is pre-scaled by the item's local '% gear X'"), but the exact in-game pooling rule for TALENT-granted chest/shield bonuses specifically (do they also stay item-local, or do they pool globally?) has not been directly observed.

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/derive.py::local_gear_defense_sources (builds one row per equipped item — grouped by (gear_slot, source_name, label) — with that item's own raw flat, its own applicable local increases, and a nested per-source breakdown) + local_gear_defense_total_from_rows (sums the per-item scaled totals; a non-gear source on the same *_gear_flat key, e.g. a bare talent "+N maximum energy shield" line, is not tied to an item so it isn't part of the per-item rows — it's added back unscaled, matching its pre-existing treatment before this per-item split). engine/defense.py::calculate_defense wires this into es_flat/armor_flat/evasion_flat and exposes the per-item rows as DefenseResult.local_gear_sources for the stat-breakdown UI (PlayerStatsScreen.tsx's LocalGearDefenseRow). Talent-granted chest/shield-targeted increases (chest_defense_inc, shield_defense_inc, shield_energy_shield_inc) join the owning item's local pool rather than the old global one.
